settingDetails: South Philadelphia rowhouses, a silver Liberty Bell, green stadium padding, real fan crowd photos, and footballs with feather trails.

gameHooks.game: Saquon cuts through a South Philly street-field, gathering footballs between rowhouse stoops.
gameHooks.bird: Restore the existing transparent winged Saquon #26 sprite; feather flaps, jersey detail, and stadium uprights are the identity.
gameHooks.search: Restore all five real Eagles crowd photographs with the existing edited Jalen appearances and exact hit rectangles as the default.
gameHooks.kick: Jake Elliott’s planted boot and a spinning football frame Liberty Bell-shaped uprights under falling stadium snow.
gameHooks.pocket: Jalen Hurts #1 steps up with his eyes downfield while three receiver routes peel apart and a safety silhouette shades the read.
gameHooks.shove: The familiar Hurts #1 wedge advances behind a close-up wall of silver-wing helmets; the pile strains visibly on every push.
gameHooks.recall: A player’s gloved hand redraws routes across a Liberty Bell playbook; a sideline audible flips the arrows.
gameHooks.punt: A spinning punt rides above the Delaware waterfront and takes a chalk-dust bounce near the painted sideline.
gameHooks.blitz: Brian Dawkins #20 crouches in a low, intense stance at the edge of a Philadelphia practice-grid tunnel.
gameHooks.signal: Midnight-green wristbands, a headset, and handwritten play cards turn the secret call into an Eagles sideline puzzle.
